'''''Glandularia''''', commonly called '''mock vervain''', is a [[genus]] of plants in the family [[Verbenaceae]]. It contains 90 species, all of which are [[native plant|native]] to the Americas, although some have naturalised in other parts of the world. ''Glandularia'' was previously treated as a [[Synonym (taxonomy)|synonym]] of a subgenus of ''[[Verbena]]''.<ref name="330555-2">{{cite web |title=Glandularia J.F.Gmel. |url=https://powo.science.kew.org/taxon/urn:lsid:ipni.org:names:330555-2 |website=Plants of the World Online |publisher=Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew |access-date=20 January 2026}}</ref>
